articles.title: ADD AUTHKIT TO YOUR EXISTING APP WITH ONE COMMAND
articles.summary:
Your app needs authentication. That means installing an SDK, wiring up callback routes, configuring middleware, and getting the environment right. Or run one command: npx workos@latest install [4].

The WorkOS AI installer [4] detects your supported framework and adapts AuthKit to your existing project. What it does:

* Installs the SDK * Creates authentication routes * Sets up environment variables, with post-installation validation enabled by default

REDESIGNING SOURCE CONTROL AT ANTHROPIC
articles.summary: Anthropic replaced Git with Scion after daily merges grew from roughly 2,500 to more than 30,000. The centralized system uses server-side commits, sparse checkouts, and layered caches, reducing its source control infrastructure's CPU and memory footprint by 200 times and freeing 25% of CI CPU capacity.

articles.title: REWINDING THE EXPONENTIAL: HOW WE KEEP HARDWARE USAGE DOWN
articles.summary: Cloudflare's data pipeline handles roughly two billion events per second while hardware capacity grows more slowly than traffic. Product-specific schemas, zstd compression, later replication, earlier sampling, and aggregation have collectively deferred the equivalent of two and a half years of hardware expansion.

articles.title: A YEAR OF FAST APPLY: THE PATH TO 10K TOKENS PER SECOND
articles.summary: Relace explains how it built a small model that applies code edits at a reported 10,000 tokens per second using high-quality merge data, LoRA fine-tuning, FP8 quantization, and speculative decoding. Its training pipeline filtered 200,000 candidate examples down to about 145,000, using a judge calibrated against 500 manually reviewed merges. Relace Apply 3 supports a 256,000-token context and multiple diff formats, although improving frontier-model edit accuracy could eventually reduce the need for specialized apply models.

articles.title: HOW TO BE MORE AMBITIOUS: A TUTORIAL FOR HUMANS WITH MODELS
articles.summary: More ambitious AI use can mean pursuing higher-level outcomes, applying expert methods to raw data, or combining ideas from multiple fields. Practical examples show how to move beyond generating a quarterly slide deck toward identifying urgent decisions, testing assumptions, and validating results with independent tools.

articles.title: RECREATIONAL PROGRAMMING
articles.summary: Programming for curiosity and enjoyment can restore motivation without requiring a business case or a finished product. This presentation suggests small experiments, toy implementations, language exploration, and documenting the process, with permission to switch projects or stop when they stop being fun.

articles.title: AI AGENTS ARE THE PRIMARY READERS OF MINTLIFY-POWERED SITES.
articles.summary: In August, agents made 257 million web requests versus 131 million human page loads, nearly 2:1. The report covers what that means for how you write and maintain docs.

articles.title: GEMINI 4 ARGON
articles.summary: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 4 Argon for complex software engineering, scientific research, robotics, and professional workflows. The model offers a one-million-token output window, and Google reports uses ranging from large Chromium refactors to physics-ready robot simulations and vulnerability remediation.

articles.title: FRONTIER MODELS FOR EVERY ROBOT: ANNOUNCING THE PI API BETA
articles.summary: Physical Intelligence's API beta lets developers upload robot demonstrations, fine-tune its models on managed infrastructure, and run inference through a hosted gateway. Early partners independently improved policies across manufacturing and other applications, although some deployments exposed network connectivity challenges.

articles.title: TANSTACK START 1.0 IS STABLE
articles.summary: TanStack Start 1.0 is now stable and ready for production, formalizing a commitment to its APIs after extensive real-world use. It combines type-safe routing with server rendering, typed server functions, and middleware spanning client and server, while shipping current agent guidance through TanStack Intent.

articles.title: OPENAI ENGINEER ARRESTED OVER ALLEGED CONFERENCE ROOM BUGGING
articles.summary: Federal prosecutors charged an OpenAI engineer with using or attempting to use a device to intercept conversations after a concealed recorder was found in an executive conference room. OpenAI says it referred the discovery to the FBI and has found no indication that model weights, source code, or customer data were improperly accessed or taken.

articles.title: ARE HARNESSES WORTH THE COST?
articles.summary: In ten runs on one Java API service, a behavioral harness raised GPT-6 Luna's acceptance rate from three successes to ten, while GPT-6 Sol passed all ten runs with or without it. Harnessed Luna cost about 33% less per run than unharnessed Sol, but those estimates exclude harness maintenance and the unusually detailed brief limits how broadly the results apply.

articles.title: THE “ALIEN” ECONOMICS OF AI MONETIZATION
articles.summary: Two-thirds of the Forbes AI 50 companies use some form of usage-based pricing as variable AI costs push businesses toward hybrid subscriptions, credits, and outcome charges. Examples from AI companies show why spending controls, flexible packaging, measurable customer value, and pricing pages readable by both people and agents are becoming part of the product.

articles.title: GIVE YOUR AGENT A BILLION PRODUCTS TO SHOP FROM
articles.summary: Building an agent or shopping app? shop.dev [18] gives you one API to access over a billion products and one-tap checkout. Try it before

articles.title: PULSE LOCAL
articles.summary: Pulse Local is a budgeting app that keeps both financial data and AI models on your machine, so your ledger and questions stay local.

articles.title: I POSTED TO HN, AND THEN MY WEBSITE WAS FLOODED WITH AI BOT TRAFFIC
articles.summary: After a Hacker News post, heavy automated traffic slowed a feed reader, prompting endpoint logging, blocking an aggressive scraper, rate limits, and infrastructure improvements.

articles.title: BIFROST
articles.summary: Bifrost is an open-source AI gateway with an OpenAI-compatible API, provider failover, load balancing, semantic caching, virtual keys, budgets, and MCP support.

articles.title: THE RISE OF DEPLOYCOS
articles.summary: AI deployment companies embed engineers inside enterprises to connect models to real workflows, build evaluations, and manage the organizational changes needed to turn model capabilities into business results.
